scope: In-source attribution lines of crypto-bigint 0.7.10 (Windows, macOS and Android selections) that the selected LICENSE-MIT does not carry; whether they are delivered and in which form. Not final application compliance or installer delivery.

notices.text_first_line: //! Adapted from the Apache 2.0+MIT licensed implementation originally from:

notices.holder: Sam Kumar (jedi-pairing), with the relicensing permission quoted in the file

halo2curves.finding: At a835096 the repository ships LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE without a copyright line and no NOTICE file; Cargo.toml says authors = ["Privacy Scaling Explorations team"], license = "MIT/Apache-2.0". The line in safegcd.rs is therefore the only copyright notice of the adapted code.

num-bigint.finding: LICENSE-MIT at 2cea7f4 reads "Copyright (c) 2014 The Rust Project Developers", the holder named in mul.rs.

jedi-pairing.finding: bigint.hpp at c4bf151 is BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2018 Sam Kumar and Copyright (c) 2018 University of California, Berkeley. Sam Kumar wrote on 2022-12-24 in https://github.com/RustCrypto/crypto-bigint/pull/133#discussion_r1056870411: "I'm OK with it being licensed as Apache 2.0 + MIT."

output.check: Each quoted block equals the named line range of the archive file byte for byte.

decision: cargo:crypto-bigint@0.7.10 keeps MIT and its LICENSE-MIT and additionally delivers the three attribution blocks verbatim in crypto-bigint-0.7.10-SOURCE-NOTICES.txt, in all three selections (the selection policy retains associated copyright and source notices; pattern: ring-0.17.14-source-copyright-NOTICES.txt). No BSD-3-Clause text is added for the schoolbook translation: the crate declares Apache-2.0 OR MIT and documents the author's permission. Remaining doubt: the permission comes from the individual author, not from the co-holder UC Berkeley; if maximal caution is wanted, ship the original BSD-3-Clause header of bigint.hpp.

other_crates.method: Copyright lines in the Rust sources of runtime crates whose holder appears in none of the delivered texts of that crate; contains false positives.
candidates: futures-channel 0.3.34 src/mpsc/queue.rs (Dmitry Vyukov, BSD-2-style header with a binary-reproduction clause)
other_crates.not_affected: tao, dpi and russh select Apache-2.0; ring, base64ct, subtle and urlpattern were false positives.
